name: Estado geral da central
command: echo '=== CUSTOMROM ESTADO GERAL ==='; date; echo; echo '--- MODELO ---'; getprop ro.product.model; echo '--- FABRICANTE ---'; getprop ro.product.manufacturer; echo '--- HARDWARE ---'; getprop ro.hardware; echo '--- PLATAFORMA ---'; getprop ro.board.platform; echo '--- BUILD ---'; getprop ro.build.display.id; echo '--- ANDROID ---'; getprop ro.build.version.release; echo '--- ABI ---'; getprop ro.product.cpu.abilist; echo; echo '--- MEMORIA ---'; cat /proc/meminfo; echo; echo '--- SWAP ---'; cat /proc/swaps; echo; echo '--- ARMAZENAMENTO ---'; df -h

name: Memória, swap e ZRAM
command: echo '=== MEMORIA ==='; cat /proc/meminfo; echo; echo '=== SWAP ==='; cat /proc/swaps; echo; echo '=== ZRAM ==='; ls -l /sys/block/zram* 2>/dev/null; for z in /sys/block/zram*/mm_stat; do [ -f "$z" ] && { echo "--- $z ---"; cat "$z"; }; done

name: Processos mais pesados
command: echo '=== TOP ==='; top -b -n 1 -m 30 2>/dev/null || top -n 1; echo; echo '=== CPUINFO DUMPSYS ==='; dumpsys cpuinfo 2>/dev/null; echo; echo '=== PS ==='; ps -A

name: Rede e ADB
command: echo '=== REDE ==='; ip addr 2>/dev/null; echo; ip route 2>/dev/null; echo; echo '=== WIFI ==='; dumpsys wifi 2>/dev/null | head -n 120; echo; echo '=== ADB PROPS ==='; getprop | grep -i adb 2>/dev/null; echo; echo '=== PORTAS ==='; ss -lnt 2>/dev/null || netstat -lnt 2>/dev/null

name: Pacotes e serviços
command: echo '=== PACOTES ==='; pm list packages -f; echo; echo '=== DESATIVADOS ==='; pm list packages -d; echo; echo '=== SERVICOS ==='; dumpsys activity services 2>/dev/null

name: Logcat curto
command: logcat -d -v threadtime -t 1200

name: Snapshot completo para análise
command: echo '=== IDENTIDADE ==='; getprop; echo; echo '=== MEMORIA ==='; cat /proc/meminfo; echo; cat /proc/swaps; echo; echo '=== CPU ==='; dumpsys cpuinfo 2>/dev/null; echo; echo '=== TOP ==='; top -b -n 1 -m 40 2>/dev/null || top -n 1; echo; echo '=== DISCO ==='; df -h; echo; echo '=== PACOTES ==='; pm list packages -f; echo; echo '=== PROCESSOS ==='; ps -A; echo; echo '=== POWER ==='; dumpsys power 2>/dev/null | head -n 160

name: Temperatura e thermal
command: echo '=== THERMAL SERVICE ==='; dumpsys thermalservice 2>/dev/null; echo; echo '=== THERMAL SYSFS ==='; for z in /sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone*; do [ -r "$z/type" ] && { printf '%s: ' "$(cat $z/type 2>/dev/null)"; cat $z/temp 2>/dev/null; }; done | head -n 120

name: Energia, bateria e wake
command: echo '=== BATTERY ==='; dumpsys battery 2>/dev/null; echo; echo '=== POWER ==='; dumpsys power 2>/dev/null | head -n 220; echo; echo '=== DEVICE IDLE ==='; dumpsys deviceidle 2>/dev/null | head -n 160

name: Armazenamento e partições
command: echo '=== DF ==='; df -h; echo; echo '=== MOUNTS ==='; mount | head -n 160; echo; echo '=== STORAGE ==='; dumpsys diskstats 2>/dev/null; dumpsys mount 2>/dev/null | head -n 180

name: Fluidez e renderização
command: echo '=== SURFACEFLINGER ==='; dumpsys SurfaceFlinger 2>/dev/null | head -n 180; echo; echo '=== GFXINFO ==='; dumpsys gfxinfo 2>/dev/null | head -n 260; echo; echo '=== WINDOW ==='; dumpsys window 2>/dev/null | head -n 180

name: Tela e aplicativo em primeiro plano
command: echo '=== TOP ACTIVITY ==='; dumpsys activity activities 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'mResumedActivity|topResumedActivity|ResumedActivity' | head -n 20; echo; echo '=== WINDOW FOCUS ==='; dumpsys window 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'mCurrentFocus|mFocusedApp' | head -n 20; echo; echo '=== DISPLAY ==='; dumpsys display 2>/dev/null | head -n 100

name: Aplicativos instalados pelo usuário
command: pm list packages -3 -f -u

name: Aplicativos desativados
command: pm list packages -d -f -u

name: Configuração de tela
command: echo '=== WM SIZE ==='; wm size; echo '=== WM DENSITY ==='; wm density; echo '=== BRILHO ==='; settings get system screen_brightness; settings get system screen_brightness_mode; echo '=== ROTACAO ==='; settings get system accelerometer_rotation; settings get system user_rotation; echo '=== TIMEOUT ==='; settings get system screen_off_timeout

name: Estado das animações Android
command: echo 'window_animation_scale='$(settings get global window_animation_scale); echo 'transition_animation_scale='$(settings get global transition_animation_scale); echo 'animator_duration_scale='$(settings get global animator_duration_scale)

name: Áudio e rotas ativas
command: echo '=== AUDIO ==='; dumpsys audio 2>/dev/null | head -n 260; echo; echo '=== MEDIA SESSION ==='; dumpsys media_session 2>/dev/null | head -n 160

name: Bluetooth e dispositivos
command: echo '=== BLUETOOTH ==='; dumpsys bluetooth_manager 2>/dev/null | head -n 260; echo; echo '=== BT PROPS ==='; getprop | grep -i bluetooth | head -n 80

name: Serviços iniciados no boot
command: echo '=== BOOT COMPLETED RECEIVERS ==='; dumpsys package 2>/dev/null | grep -B2 -A6 'android.intent.action.BOOT_COMPLETED' | head -n 320; echo; echo '=== RUNNING SERVICES ==='; dumpsys activity services 2>/dev/null | head -n 320

name: Configurações técnicas atuais
command: echo '=== GLOBAL SELECTED ==='; settings get global adb_enabled; settings get global development_settings_enabled; settings get global stay_on_while_plugged_in; settings get global window_animation_scale; settings get global transition_animation_scale; settings get global animator_duration_scale; echo; echo '=== SYSTEM SELECTED ==='; settings get system accelerometer_rotation; settings get system user_rotation; settings get system screen_off_timeout

name: Desativar animações do sistema
command: settings put global window_animation_scale 0; settings put global transition_animation_scale 0; settings put global animator_duration_scale 0; echo 'Animações definidas para 0x'

name: Restaurar animações em 1x
command: settings put global window_animation_scale 1; settings put global transition_animation_scale 1; settings put global animator_duration_scale 1; echo 'Animações restauradas para 1x'

name: Ativar rotação automática
command: settings put system accelerometer_rotation 1; echo 'Rotação automática ativada'

name: Desativar rotação automática
command: settings put system accelerometer_rotation 0; echo 'Rotação automática desativada'

name: Manter tela ligada durante carga
command: svc power stayon true; echo 'Tela configurada para permanecer ligada durante alimentação'

name: Restaurar comportamento normal da tela
command: svc power stayon false; echo 'Comportamento normal de suspensão restaurado'

name: Inspecionar hierarquia da tela atual
command: uiautomator dump /data/local/tmp/customrom_ui.xml >/dev/null 2>&1; cat /data/local/tmp/customrom_ui.xml 2>/dev/null; rm -f /data/local/tmp/customrom_ui.xml

name: Por que a central está lenta?
command: echo '=== MEMORIA RESUMO ==='; grep -E 'MemTotal|MemAvailable|SwapTotal|SwapFree' /proc/meminfo; echo; echo '=== CPU TOP ==='; dumpsys cpuinfo 2>/dev/null | head -n 80; echo; echo '=== TOP PROCESSOS ==='; top -b -n 1 -m 25 2>/dev/null || top -n 1; echo; echo '=== DISCO ==='; df -h; echo; echo '=== THERMAL ==='; dumpsys thermalservice 2>/dev/null | head -n 100
